market_reason: 10-year Treasury yield above 5% with accelerating global bond selloff and expectations of further Fed hikes, plus Nvidia CEO resignation shock, but equities are roughly flat and recovering, so not a crisis-grade event.
market_headlines: Treasury Selloff Accelerates, European Bonds Follow Suit - WSJ

summary: Nvidia's CEO resignation and a Treasury selloff (10-year above 5%, Fed hike talk) are the main stories, yet equity indexes are little changed and recovered most early losses. Oil is rebounding on Iran tensions, which supports the energy holdings, and the Paraguay bank collapse and Mexico tariff threat are not directly material to these ETFs.
